3.41.m: And I will speak to Kṛṣṇa; he will render you assistance. / He is indeed my very self, devoted to me, and the accomplisher of my tasks.

3.41.s:
matprabhāvānbhārata tvaṃ rājyannikaṇṭakaṃ kuru |
dhīrmmānnānāvidhānbhrātrā kāraya tvaṃ ca sarvadā ||
3.41.d:
मत्प्रभावान्भारत त्वं राज्यन्निकण्टकं कुरु ।
धीर्म्मान्नानाविधान्भ्रात्रा कारय त्वं च सर्वदा ॥
3.41.m: By my power, O descendant of Bharata, make your kingdom free of thorns; / being wise, always cause diverse deeds to be performed through your brother.

3.41.s:
nandīśvara uvāca |
ityuktvā nijahastaṃ ca dhṛtvā śirasi tasya saḥ |
pūjito hyarjunenāśu śaṅkaro'ntaradhīyata ||
3.41.d:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच ।
इत्युक्त्वा निजहस्तं च धृत्वा शिरसि तस्य सः ।
पूजितो ह्यर्जुनेनाशु शङ्करोऽन्तरधीयत ॥
3.41.m: Nandīśvara said: / Having spoken thus and placed his own hand upon his head, / Śaṅkara, worshipped quickly by Arjuna, vanished.

3.41.s:
athārjunaḥ prasannātmā prāpyāstraṃ ca varaṃ prabhoḥ |
jagāma svāśramaṃ mukhyaṃ smaranbhaktyā guruṃ śivam ||
3.41.d:
अथार्जुनः प्रसन्नात्मा प्राप्यास्त्रं च वरं प्रभोः ।
जगाम स्वाश्रमं मुख्यं स्मरन्भक्त्या गुरुं शिवम् ॥
3.41.m: Then Arjuna, his mind delighted upon obtaining the weapon and the boon from the Lord, / went to his chief hermitage, remembering with devotion his guru Śiva.

3.41.s:
sarve te bhrātaraḥ prītāstanvaḥ prāṇamivāgatam |
militvā taṃ sukhaṃ prāpurdraupadī cātisuvratā ||
3.41.d:
सर्वे ते भ्रातरः प्रीतास्तन्वः प्राणमिवागतम् ।
मिलित्वा तं सुखं प्रापुर्द्रौपदी चातिसुव्रता ॥
3.41.m: All his brothers were delighted, as if life had returned to their bodies; / having met him, they and the deeply virtuous Draupadī obtained joy.

3.41.s:
śivaṃ paraṃ ca santuṣṭaṃ pāṇḍavāḥ sarva eva hi |
nātṛpyansarvavṛttāntaṃ śrutvā harṣamupāgatāḥ ||
3.41.d:
शिवं परं च सन्तुष्टं पाण्डवाः सर्व एव हि ।
नातृप्यन्सर्ववृत्तान्तं श्रुत्वा हर्षमुपागताः ॥
3.41.m: Indeed, all the Pāṇḍavas were exceedingly pleased, / and hearing the entire account, they were filled with joy and could not be satisfied.

3.41.s:
āśrame puṣpavṛṣṭiśca candanena samanvitā |
papāta sukarārthaṃ ca teṣāṃ caiva mahātmanām ||
3.41.d:
आश्रमे पुष्पवृष्टिश्च चन्दनेन समन्विता ।
पपात सुकरार्थं च तेषां चैव महात्मनाम् ॥
3.41.m: And a shower of flowers accompanied by sandalwood fell / in the hermitage for the welfare of those great-souled men.

3.41.s:
dhanyaṃ ca śaṅkaraṃ caiva namaskṛtya śivammudā |
avadhiṃ cāgataṃ jñātvā jayaścaiva bhaviṣyati ||
3.41.d:
धन्यं च शङ्करं चैव नमस्कृत्य शिवम्मुदा ।
अवधिं चागतं ज्ञात्वा जयश्चैव भविष्यति ॥
3.41.m: Bowing with joy to the blessed Śaṅkara, to Śiva, / and knowing that the appointed time had arrived, [they realized that] victory would surely come.

3.41.s:
etasminnantare kṛṣṇaḥ śrutvārjunamathāgatam |
melanāya samāyātaḥ śrutvā sukhamupāgataḥ ||
3.41.d:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे कृष्णः श्रुत्वार्जुनमथागतम् ।
मेलनाय समायातः श्रुत्वा सुखमुपागतः ॥
3.41.m: Meanwhile, Kṛṣṇa, having heard that Arjuna had returned, / came to meet him, and hearing [the news], was filled with joy.

3.41.s:
ataścaiva mayākhyātaḥ śaṅkaraḥ sarvaduḥkhahā |
sa sevyate mayā nityaṃ bhavadbhirapi sevyatām ||
3.41.d:
अतश्चैव मयाख्यातः शङ्करः सर्वदुःखहा ।
स सेव्यते मया नित्यं भवद्भिरपि सेव्यताम् ॥
3.41.m: Therefore, Śaṅkara, the destroyer of all sorrow, has been described by me. / He is constantly served by me; let him be served by you as well.

3.41.s:
ityuktaste kirātāhvo'vatāraḥ śaṅkarasya vai |
taṃ śrutvā śrāvayanvāpi sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt ||
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ||
śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ ||
śrīśivamahāpurāṇam ||
tṛtīyāyāṃ śatarudrasaṃhitāyāṃ
3.41.d:
इत्युक्तस्ते किराताह्वोऽवतारः शङ्करस्य वै ।
तं श्रुत्वा श्रावयन्वापि सर्वान्कामानवाप्नुयात् ॥
श्रीगणेशाय नमः ॥
श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः ॥
श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥
तृतीयायां शतरुद्रसंहितायां
3.41.m:
Thus the incarnation of Śaṅkara named Kirāta has been told to you. / By hearing it or making others hear it, one obtains all desires.

Thus ends the forty-first chapter, named 'The Description of the Kirāteśvara Incarnation', in the third book, the Śatarudrasaṃhitā, of the glorious Śivamahāpurāṇa.
